sources.title: Restoring Punctuation in Uzbek Texts Using LLM's Fine Tuning Approaches
sources.snippet: Solving this problem requires the development of robust models capable of correctly recovering punctuation marks in texts written in languages with complex linguistic structures, such as Uzbek. This paper presents a new approach that uses fine-tuning models based on specially adapted transformers to restore punctuation marks in Uzbek texts.
